title: COMPARE — BIOMARKERS table
description: Array of donor records. One element is one donor in the Nightingale biomarker results (biomarkers sheet), visit 1. A blank in the provider's data is written as null; the dictionary's own codes are kept as constants.
$comment: Category files are wired into allOf as each category is converted. JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of rows across the table; the identifier's format and whether the other tables carry it are open questions for the data provider (D009).
